How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi is 17th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M. Sc. in Physics, Mathematics, Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, Oceanography, or Earth Sciences with first class and a valid NET/GATE qualification, or a B. Tech/M. Tech in Atmospheric Sciences or equivalent with first class and GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete application with all required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5% relaxation of marks is provided for SC/ST candidates. Specific age limits are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITD/IRD/197/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow at IIT Delhi is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
